repeats.name: Ha-neul
repeats.line: Another pass over the same ground. Somebody's being careful. Careful people leave cleaner trails — and cleaner trails are still trails.

moots.conveneLine: Jian has been talking at the fires. Enough voices — tonight they call a moot. Werner answers for what happened to Jian.
